description: This file defines the implementation of a service that calculates the state of a shopping cart in an e-commerce application. It handles recalculating prices, discounts, subtotals, and totals for shopping cart items, integrating with order and shopping cart services.

classes.name: ShoppingCartCalculationServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation class responsible for calculating the state of the shopping cart, including price calculations and discounts, ensuring the shopping cart's total amounts are accurate.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Recalculates the shopping cart's total and updates its state, accepting the shopping cart, customer, store, and language context; throws ServiceException if errors occur.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Calculates the shopping cart total based on the cart, store, and language, updating the cart model; throws ServiceException if errors occur.

methods.name: updateCartModel
methods.description: Persists the updated shopping cart model via the shoppingCartService.
